# NAACP

> > America's largest and most influential civil rights organization, fighting for racial equity, social justice, and equal opportunity since 1909.

The NAACP (National Association for the Advancement of Colored People) leads advocacy campaigns on voting rights, criminal justice reform, economic justice, environmental justice, and healthcare equity. Led by President Derrick Johnson, the organization mobilizes communities through grassroots organizing, policy advocacy, and cultural celebration including the annual NAACP Image Awards.

## Key Topics

- Racial equity and civil rights
- Voter mobilization and civic engagement
- Criminal justice reform
- Environmental justice and climate action
- Healthcare equity and Medicaid access
- Economic justice and financial stability
- Student debt relief
- Cannabis decriminalization
- Social Security and federal budget advocacy
- Derrick Johnson (President & CEO)
- National Youth Work Committee
- Democracy and election participation
- Project 2025 opposition
- Community organizing and grassroots advocacy

## Advocacy Campaigns & Actions

- [Decriminalize Cannabis](https://naacp.org/actions/decriminalize-cannabis): Advocacy campaign for cannabis decriminalization and criminal justice reform
- [Losing Medicaid: An Equity Disaster](https://naacp.org/campaigns/losing-medicaid-equity-disaster): Campaign tracking Medicaid unwinding impact on communities of color by state
- [National Virtual Town Hall: Debt. Cancelled.](https://naacp.org/events/national-virtual-town-hall-debt-cancelled): Virtual town hall on Biden-Harris student debt relief for Black borrowers
- [All Units Call: Project 2025](https://naacp.org/events/all-units-call-project-2025): Community organizing event to counter Project 2025 policy agenda

## Voter Engagement & Democracy

- [Vote Early Day](https://naacp.org/events/vote-early-day): Vote Early Day event promoting voter registration and civic engagement
- [Call to Action: California Power Hour](https://naacp.org/events/call-action-california-power-hour): California voter mobilization event for Prop 50 grassroots organizing
- [Federal Budget & Tax Fight](https://naacp.org/events/federal-budget-tax-fight): Community call on federal budget, tax policy, and Social Security advocacy

## Environmental & Climate Justice

- [March to End Fossil Fuels](https://naacp.org/events/march-end-fossil-fuels): NYC climate march event addressing environmental justice in Black communities

## Cultural Celebration

- [57th NAACP Image Awards](https://naacp.org/events/57th-naacp-image-awards): Annual NAACP Image Awards ceremony celebrating diversity in entertainment

## Educational Resources

- [Oscar Micheaux](https://naacp.org/find-resources/history-explained/civil-rights-leaders/oscar-micheaux): Profile of Oscar Micheaux, pioneering Black filmmaker and homesteader
- [Seeking Stability](https://naacp.org/credit-101/stability): Credit 101 guide on building credit scores and financial stability

## Leadership & Board Members

- [Rev. Dr. Wendell Anthony](https://naacp.org/people/reverend-wendell-anthony): Detroit NAACP President and civil rights leader Rev. Dr. Wendell Anthony
- [Rick L. Callender](https://naacp.org/people/rick-l-callender): California/Hawaii State Conference President Rick L. Callender profile
- [Rabbi Jonah Pesner](https://naacp.org/people/rabbi-jonah-pesner): NAACP Board Member Rabbi Jonah Pesner of Religious Action Center
- [Claude Cummings, Jr.](https://naacp.org/people/claude-cummings-jr): CWA District 6 VP and NAACP National Board Member Claude Cummings Jr.
- [Keisha Deonarine Bross](https://naacp.org/people/keisha-deonarine-bross): KDB Consulting founder focused on economic justice and inclusive economy
- [Kyra Mitchell](https://naacp.org/people/kyra-mitchell): Region 3 Youth Board Member Kyra Mitchell from Saginaw, Michigan
- [Ericka Cain](https://naacp.org/people/ericka-cain): Texas Youth & College Division leader Ericka Cain from Fort Worth
